notes: Design role/step labels do not confer authored node identity or execution authority

Preserve exact imported task identities and evaluator/native scoring targets

targets.success_condition: Assign each required party exactly once
targets.evidence_required: Application party roster + party assessments

targets.success_condition: Verify the right subject through a permitted current route or record an unresolved gap

targets.success_condition: Read the assigned profile before assessing it

targets.success_condition: Associate each current check with the right party and handle unresolved results

targets.success_condition: Match a reviewed permitted disposition including justified holds

targets.skill_name: Request the specific next evidence or action

targets.success_condition: Link the assessment to current evidence read in this case

targets.success_condition: Match the revision declared in the final assessment to the current sealed case revision

targets.success_condition: Apply the reviewed eligibility conditions for this product to the right facts

targets.success_condition: Confirm required party-specific agreements or identify what is missing

targets.success_condition: Support each authority claim or escalate an unresolved authority question
